ribbed (10 BLO sts worked into every body row, 6.9 cm)
65 cm stated; ~mid-thigh on the 160 cm model
crumpled waffle: alternating BLO/FLO hdc, checkered surface
Stonewash (named); dusty pink in the seller's photographs

discrepancies.finding: the generator draws the fabric 1.6-3.6x coarser than the pattern's 14.5 st x 9.5 rows per 10 cm on 9 of 12 draws; the reader independently called two of those 'child-sized'
discrepancies.traced_to: generative presentation (the model invents a gauge) and the reference's pixel scale (4.5 px per stitch at 1024 px); a 1.6x larger reference reduced but did not remove it

discrepancies.finding: the reader called the generated texture 'other' (seed-stitch-like) on 11 of 14 candidate reads and 'waffle_textured' on 3; the seller's photographs read waffle 3 of 4
discrepancies.traced_to: generative presentation: the material re-synthesis changes the stitch look while keeping an all-over texture
discrepancies.material: borderline: for a pattern listing the stitch is the design's identity; the gate accepts any all-over texture today
discrepancies.gated: no (recorded as the next instrument to build: per-stitch correspondence once gauge is held)

discrepancies.property: invented feature: ribbed inserts at the upper sleeves
discrepancies.finding: rounds 1-3 carried a ribbed patch at each shoulder; the reader caught it on 2 of 3 round-3 draws and missed it on 6 of 6 earlier
discrepancies.traced_to: full-product geometry: the reference drew the sleeve's cuff stitches (fabric position 0-9) at the shoulder end; fixed in ref3
discrepancies.gated: partly: the reader's extra_features check is unreliable for small invented features

discrepancies.finding: read 'three_quarter' on 2 of 12 candidates (flat lay) against 'long' on all four seller photographs
discrepancies.traced_to: validation: a flat lay does not show where a sleeve falls on a body; the reader guesses from proportion
discrepancies.gated: yes, and it fails the candidate when read wrong (strict)

discrepancies.finding: pattern: vertical; reader: horizontal on 3 of 4 seller photographs, none on the reference and most candidates
discrepancies.traced_to: validation: the reader cannot read this property even on ground truth (the bands' ridges dominate)

discrepancies.finding: the pattern leaves it to the maker; the reference assumes centred on each front, 5 cm above the hem rib; the seller's photographs show pockets low on the fronts near the hem, consistent with the assumption
discrepancies.gated: pocket count and hip position are gated; exact placement is not

discrepancies.finding: the pattern names the colourway only; the seller's photographs show dusty pink; the pattern's own process photographs show a blue-grey sample
discrepancies.traced_to: missing physical information: colour is not derivable from text; RGB taken from the seller photograph of the named colourway and declared

discrepancies.finding: reads as a chunkier, more oversized garment than photographs 1-3 (a different make or yarn); all four agree with Product Truth on every gated property
discrepancies.traced_to: benchmark material: not every seller photograph is the sample garment

discrepancies.finding: sound only under the pattern's implied chain gauge (18.65 per 10 cm, +-6 %); at stitch gauge the slit reads 38.6 cm against a 31.6 cm sleeve top
discrepancies.traced_to: pattern parsing / CIR: chains are narrower than stitches and the pattern does not state chain gauge
